svg.title: feel — I didn't come this far just to come this far.
svg.desc: A monochrome engraved elephant assembles from anatomical construction lines, then sends a red impulse through an illustrated map of ten projects. Each project performs its own animated sequence. The rotating spotlight shows actual interface captures, with original mod assets for Gems. TypeShift and Doompedia lead, followed by Planora, SystemForge, RPS, MANTA, Anubis, Gems, Commit, and Portfolio. The links below open each repository. Connections are illustrative, not software dependencies.
